meta.title: Dev Fighter — CSS challenges for front-end developers
meta.description: Recreate the target with HTML & CSS. Closest match with the shortest code wins. Shape and real UI challenges, learning tracks, and live battles.

home.subtitle: Shape and real-UI challenges you solve with HTML & CSS. Your result is compared with the target pixel by pixel — then you climb the leaderboard against developers everywhere.

steps.title: See the target
steps.text: A shape or a piece of UI, with the exact colours it uses.

steps.title: Write HTML & CSS
steps.text: A code editor next to a live preview, and a slider to compare your result with the target.

steps.title: Score points
steps.text: The closer you get to a perfect match — with shorter code — the higher you rank.

shapes.title: Shapes
shapes.text: Visual puzzles made of simple shapes on a 400×300 canvas — a great way to think in CSS.

components.title: Real UI
components.text: Rebuild a button, a card or a navbar the way you see them on real sites — the skill you use at work.

items.title: Learning tracks
items.text: From easy to hard — every challenge teaches a new property.

items.title: Hints
items.text: Stuck? Open a hint for a small share of the points.

items.title: Explained solutions
items.text: After you solve it, read how the best solutions work and pick up new tricks.

battles.title: Live 1v1 battles
battles.text: Same challenge, same timer, and your opponent's match % moving in front of you. Who reaches the target first?

final.title: Ready to fight?
final.text: Sign in with GitHub or Google and start for free.

challenges.title: Challenges
challenges.subtitle: Pick a challenge and start. Your match updates live as you type.

play.metaDescription: “{title}”: recreate the target with HTML & CSS and watch your match update live.
play.resetConfirm: Your current code will be replaced with the starter code. Continue?
play.slideHint: Move over the output, or use the slider, to reveal the target
play.diffHint: Red: pixels that differ from the target. Yellow: soft edges, not counted.
play.diffLabel: Difference between your output and the target
play.estimate: Instant estimate in your browser while you type. Official scoring and leaderboards come next.
play.perfect: Perfect match! Now try making your code shorter.
play.unsupported: This browser can't measure the match live. Try Chrome, Edge or Firefox.

tips.title: Tips & tricks for shorter code
tips.metaDescription: The best ways to shorten your HTML & CSS in Dev Fighter challenges, each with a before-and-after example and the characters it saves.
tips.intro: A 100% match is only half the job — the other half is the shortest code possible. These are the tricks the pros use, each with a before-and-after example that draws exactly the same picture.
tips.disclaimer: These tricks win challenges; they're not how to write CSS for real websites. At work, write clear code and let your build tools minify it.
tips.result: Result — the same picture before and after
tips.ctaText: Pick a challenge, reach 100%, then start shortening your code.
